# Prompt Haven

> Prompt Haven is a free site for AI photo editing prompts. Each guide has 10 original copy and paste prompts for Google Gemini and ChatGPT, for Christmas, couples, family, babies, festive seasons and trending portrait styles. Prompts are free. Results vary by tool and photo.
